page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance within the ecs.gn5 family, operating under the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a baseline ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per core. Compute and parallel processing capabilities are augmented by two bundled NVIDIA P100 GPUs, yielding a cumulative graphics memory capacity of 32 GB VRAM. Storage needs are met by 944 GB of attached local SSD capacity, while network throughput is backed by a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth allowance.

The allocation of 56 dedicated virtual processors ensures stable CPU output without hypervisor-level contention. Bundling dual NVIDIA P100 accelerators alongside dedicated local SSD storage provides integrated compute, memory, and high-speed local disk capacity in a single hardware envelope. From a cost-efficiency perspective, provisioning physical GPU hardware alongside a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio allows efficient host resource utilization alongside parallel math execution. However, fixed local SSD storage and specialized accelerator hardware mean resource efficiency depends heavily on whether workloads fully utilize the fixed hardware configuration.

Given the combination of 56 vCPUs, 224 GB of RAM, two NVIDIA P100 GPUs with 32 GB VRAM total, and local SSD storage, the instance is targeted toward accelerated compute workloads. Typical application areas include deep learning training and inference, high-performance computing, video transcoding, parallel graphics processing, and scientific simulation pipelines requiring dedicated host compute and GPU acceleration.
